summary: Wrote test spec tests/specs/PD-01-02.md covering all 11 required test cases for PD-01 and PD-02 (TC-PD-01-01 through TC-PD-01-04 and TC-PD-02-01 through TC-PD-02-11). Created tests/integration/definition_test.zig with all 11 integration tests using the TestHarness pattern against a real PostgreSQL database — no SkipZigTest usage anywhere. Updated main_test.zig to include the new definition_test. Also updated src/bpm.zig to export definition/store.zig as bpm.definition so the integration test module can access Store, CreateParams, and type aliases. Fixed a pre-existing blocking compile error in src/definition/store.zig: std.json.stringify (old API) was replaced with std.json.Stringify.valueAlloc (Zig 0.16 API). zig build test exits 0 (all unit tests pass). zig build test-integration compiles cleanly; runtime tests fail only because BPM_TEST_DB_URL is not set in this environment, which is expected.

tests_run.name: zig build test (all unit tests)
tests_run.detail: exit 0; includes CHK-01..CHK-08 graph validator tests and all Stage-1 unit tests

tests_run.name: zig build test-integration (compile check)
tests_run.detail: Compiles without errors; runtime tests fail with MissingTestDbUrl (expected — no DB in this environment)

issues_found.description: src/definition/store.zig used std.json.stringify which was removed in Zig 0.16. Replaced with std.json.Stringify.valueAlloc. This was a pre-existing compile blocker that prevented the integration test suite from building.

next_steps: Route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-02 Step 4) to run the integration tests against a live BPM_TEST_DB_URL database.
TEST-RUNNER should run: zig build test-integration (with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set) to execute all 11 definition integration tests.
After integration tests pass, update PD-01 and PD-02 requirement status to TESTED in docs/status/requirement_status.json.
